title: CHSH inequality always holds in bipartite qutrits with spin-1 observables
summary: Bell inequalities reveal when quantum correlations cannot be explained by any local hidden-variable model, and the CHSH inequality is the most fundamental test of this phenomenon. While entangled two-qubit states can violate CHSH inequalities with suitable local measurements, the situation is more subtle for higher-dimensional systems when the allowed observables are physically restricted. In this work, we study bipartite qutrit systems in which each party is restricted to spin-1 observables $S(u)=u_xS_x+u_yS_y+u_zS_z$, with $u\in\mathbb R^3$ a unit vector.
